movelist.name: Block
movelist.effect: The target is Stuck and Trapped until the beginning of your next turn.

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Iron Defense
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.effect: The user resists Fire Type movesf one step further, and does not lose Hit Points from the Burn Condition.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.effect: The user’s Weight Class is increased by +2. Their Defense Base Stat is increased by +2, but their Speed Base Stat is decreased by 2.
